== Description ==
Our Spring update is here and it comes with a truckload of new and exciting additions to Hay Day! We have a new production machines, crops, products, a new type of decoration, a new Derby, and so much more! 

Keep checking our social media pages for sneak peaks, as well as exclusive update information - revealed by our aMOOzing YouTubers!
